root_cause.statement: The I0 provider schema and declarative signature exposed a natural-language scene_hint, while the downstream local decoder treated that optional model field as an exact canonical source-partition identifier. This crossed the v3.0 authority boundary because a model-visible semantic label could be interpreted as a local machine partition.
rejected_alternatives: Do not instruct the model to echo the current canonical scene ID: that would ask the model to mint or transport a local identifier.
Do not relax the local equality check to accept arbitrary natural-language labels: that would let free text control a machine partition.
Do not alter the frozen A1 FactExtractionDraft/FactQualifiers domain contract: the canonical episode_id and scene_id are already attached locally by A8 from the explicit source partition.

implementation: Removed scene_hint from the I0 native JSON schema and from its self-validation shape.
Removed optional scene hints from the I0 declarative output semantics and explicitly excludes scene or partition identifiers.
Strengthened the I0 system instruction so a provider cannot name or select a local scene partition.
Added boundary regression coverage proving a natural scene label in a model response is rejected both by the strict schema decoder and by the structured adapter.
repair.authority_after_repair: The provider may return only source spans, semantic types, source-supported statements, optional subject labels, and optional dialogue text. The local A8 caller remains the only authority that attaches the explicit episode/scene source partition before FactAssembler produces canonical facts, IDs, handles, provenance, and hashes.
repair.downstream_status: A8 remains invalidated. Its stale direct test port and defense-only decoder branch still mention scene_hint, but they are outside A4 allowed paths and cannot serve as current A8 evidence. They must be removed or revalidated only when A8 is later claimed; this A4 completion neither treats them as conforming nor changes their owner.

boundary_assertions.i0_partition_assignment: No I0 provider-visible field can carry a scene hint, local scene ID, or source-partition selector. The native structured adapter rejects scene_hint after transport even if a provider returns it.
boundary_assertions.canonical_authority: Provider Drafts do not create canonical IDs, hashes, ticks, boundaries, bindings, VEC, or Projection. Local deterministic assembly remains authoritative.
boundary_assertions.schema_transport: The compact JSON schema remains a dedicated transport field rather than prompt text; the repaired I0 schema is 675 characters, below its 2500-character budget.
boundary_assertions.production: v4 remains the production entry, production_switch_authorized remains false, and no Director, DP, renderer, media, or owner-approval action was started.

non_goals: No A5-A10 implementation or evidence was modified, claimed, or completed.
No v4 production path, feature gate, or production switch was changed.
No free-text model output is interpreted as a local ID, partition, binding, tick, VEC, Projection, media result, or user approval.
